contract.statement: ContentDefinitionRef, RuntimeEntityRef, BehaviorDefinitionRef, EquippedInstanceRef, ActivationSourceRef and ParameterSourceRef are different identities.

identities.Avatar: version + AvatarID; EnhancedID/variant and AvatarConfig reference remain separate
identities.Trace: owner AvatarID + PointID + row Level + source/EnhancedID variant; DB entity_id is an owner:anchor:level projection, not native PointID

identities.LightCone: EquipmentID; SkillID, EquipmentSkill Level and ability name are distinct keys

collision_example.statement: Trace 1001:point01:1 has PointID 1001001 and LevelUpSkillID 100101; Eidolon 100101 is a separate family identity. Equality across families is not a join.

architecture.statement: ProgressionLoadoutState -> ContentActivationSource -> exact binding/requirement/value edges -> BehaviorActivation -> EffectiveBehaviorSet. Every source ends with ENABLED, DISABLED_WITH_PROOF or UNRESOLVED; never disappear an unknown source.

stages: Capture immutable source packet as a sandbox boundary policy; preserve native mutability as UNKNOWN
Resolve versioned content rows and any explicitly proven effective config
Retain activation requirements independent of effect predicates
Resolve behavior/property/skill-level destinations by exact structured references
Bind receiver/owner/caster/provider/value context only when proved
Bind rank/level/point/threshold parameter record with presence semantics
Emit full provenance-bearing activation records or strict rejection
runtime_binding_model.no_boolean_collapse: Definition present, object created, registration enabled, runtime predicate true and hook triggered are separate states.

schema_chain.statement: EquipmentRow F60791 EquipmentID and F60789 SkillID -> EquipmentSkillRow F60821 SkillID / F60822 Level -> F60820 AbilityName plus F60818 AbilityProperty and F60819 ParamList. This proves distinct schema fields, not actual row equality or loader execution.

current_static_boundary.statement: 169 LightCone definitions, 845 rank rows and 1183 promotion rows exist. Current LightCone projection supplies base_type and refinements, but no explicit SkillID/AbilityName link.

legacy_join.statement: All 165 legacy EXACT_CONFIG_ID links derive numeric tokens from names such as Ability20000. They remain historical candidates, not Domain 8 promoted mappings. Existing report is unchanged.

behavior_example.statement: EquipmemtAbility.json /AbilityList/1 explicitly defines Ability20000, refers to MEquip_20000_Main, targets Caster and reads SkillEquip indices 0 and 1. No inspected Equipment row proves that content 20000 selects it.

path.statement: EquipmentRow.AvatarBaseType and static detail.base_type exist, but can-equip, stat contribution, effect enablement, and partial enablement on wrong Path remain independent unknowns. UI or text cannot supply the execution gate.
path.question: D8-Q2

runtime_owner.statement: Wearer, equipment entity, virtual component or another receiver is not established. Caster aliases in behavior are insufficient.
runtime_owner.question: D8-Q2

known.statement: The DB explicitly relates each lightcone_id to rank strings 1..5 and a param_list. Source behaviors declare ReadInfo Type SkillEquip / Index; EquipmentSkillRow is keyed by SkillID and Level. These are three separate edges.

example.status: STATIC_RECORDS_AND_READER_PROVED; content-to-behavior and rank-to-EquipmentSkill.Level remain MISSING

variant_selection.statement: S1-S5 selecting a shared definition versus a variant, effective extra rank, Level lookup, config override and parameter provider all require Q1/Q2. No value = table[rank] runtime lowering.

source_fields.statement: Current rows preserve PointID, owner_avatar_id, trace_level, default_unlock, pre_point, avatar level/promotion limits, LevelUpSkillID, StatusAddList, param_list and point_trigger_key.

counts.merge_exposure: UNKNOWN; missing source/selection edges prevent quantifying affected rows

kinds.property_surface: 970 rows have exact property_type/value contributions. STATIC_PROPERTY_CONTRIBUTION, not proven STAT_ONLY across the missing AbilityName boundary.
kinds.skill_level_surface: 3755 rows reference SkillIDs; 4561 target edges, 4243 resolve exactly and 318 are missing. Do not invent per-level offsets from the transformer.
kinds.other_surface: 293 rows have neither StatusAddList nor LevelUpSkillID; retain as UNRESOLVED_PROGRESSION_EFFECT. Do not label from icons/descriptions.
kinds.native_enum: AvatarSkillTreePointType declares Attribute, Skill, Extra, Servant, Special. Numerical enum values are not recovered from declaration order; DB point_type integers retained verbatim.

graph.statement: pre_point and level/promotion limits supply explicit requirements; their AND/OR/comparison semantics, default-unlock interaction, level selection and runtime application remain unproved. Preserve them as source constraints.
graph.question: D8-Q3

trace_model.skill_category_boundary: Normal/skill/ultimate/passive/maze/servant/special families have named native trigger keys, but numeric PointTriggerKey conversion and content-to-CharacterConfig skill identity must be proven. Do not infer basic/technique/talent solely from UI.
trace_model.stat_only_policy: Ordinary property mapping for these 970 rows is Terra-ready as a contribution edge. Whole-node activation cannot silently omit an unknown AbilityName.

observed.statement: Selected March 7th source has BySkillPointActivated(PointB1/PointB2) inside Skill02 Phase02 and PointB3 inside Skill03 Phase02. This is an explicit runtime progression gate within an ordinary ability.

separate_setup.statement: AvatarDataComponent declares SetupInitialAbility, _SetupSkillTreeAbility and _ResetSkillTreeAndRelatedProperty; AvatarRowData declares trigger-key maps and changed skill-tree lists.

timing.statement: These declarations do not show battle initialization order, whether objects preexist unlock, whether all behaviors are loaded, or whether progression can change mid-battle. Gated source tasks do not prove that the enclosing object exists before unlock.
timing.question: D8-Q3

schema.statement: 582 RankID rows preserve owner and explicit rank. Native AvatarRankConfigRow separately has RankAbility, SkillAddLevelList, Param, Trigger, Rank and RankID; the current DB projection omits RankAbility/Trigger/SkillAddLevelList.

eidolon_model.no_suffix_mapping: RankID suffix, RankNN ability name and numerical rank are not joined by appearance.

variant.statement: AvatarConfig RankIDList/EnhancedID selection and effective variant row are absent; no universal same-avatar config merge.

source_gate.statement: ByRankActivated is used repeatedly in the selected ordinary skill/passive source with TriggerKey.Hash values -1445815962, 2089636447 and 1686351920. Preserve those hashes; their rank-row relationship is missing.

native_distinction.statement: ByRankActivated has TargetType and TriggerKey; ByRankActivatedFromLineup separately has AvatarID and Rank. Do not treat them as one resolved predicate.

cumulative.statement: Owning E4 or E6 implies earlier ranks only after map construction/predicate comparisons are proved. Neither UI convention nor the method name establishes cumulative thresholds. E6-only filtering is also unjustified.
cumulative.question: D8-Q3

contract.statement: Store source RankID + explicit threshold field + target SkillID + offset/value + provenance + unresolved activation status; retain actual skill level/cap separately. Never rewrite SkillConfig.

skill_level_overrides.reason: Current projection lacks SkillAddLevelList. Cached transform_avatar_rank iterates the explicit map into id/num, proving schema intent only; actual rows are unavailable. No offsets were parsed from localized descriptions.
skill_level_overrides.trace_targets: 4561 explicit target references in ledger; 318 edges / 48 SkillIDs MISSING. Skill level effect size/cap not derived from UI or transformer hardcoded num=1.

content.statement: 60 sets have 92 explicit require_num records. Set 101 separately contains keys 2 and 4; these preserve distinct parameter records, not runtime activation semantics.

items.statement: 184 static relic item definition IDs exactly match RelicConfig.ID, giving SetID, Type, Mode and Rarity. They are definition rows, not a character inventory or valid equipped-instance multiset.

schema.statement: RelicSetConfigRow has SetSkillList/SetID. RelicSetSkillConfigRow has SetID/RequireNum/AbilityName/PropertyList/AbilityParamList. Static projection omits those behavior/property columns.

reader.statement: Equip30 Ability51231 declares SkillRelic with literal TriggerKey 123_4 and indices 0,1,2. Parsing that string into SetID 123 and threshold 4 requires a proved key rule; M537530/M537531 are key-generator declarations only.

independent_thresholds.statement: Separate 2/4 rows must be preserved. Count 4 -> both effects, only one effect, or 4pc containing 2pc are all unproved.
independent_thresholds.question: D8-Q4

count_rules.statement: Duplicate concrete pieces, one-per-slot validation, relic mode eligibility, count overrides and attachment receiver remain unproved. Do not count rows in static RelicConfig or deduplicate by SetID.

evidence.statement: Equipment source AddModifier operations explicitly target Caster, CasterServant and ModifierOwnerEntity in different contexts. These are symbolic target consumers, not a native mapping from equipped wearer to behavior owner.

inspected.statement: 143 cached AvatarConfig roots and 16 equipment behavior files were checked for binding-relevant parent/override root fields. None of the selected parent keys was found. Collider-camera override fields were excluded from behavior inheritance.

unresolved.statement: No observed parent field does not prove native merge absence. AvatarID/EnhancedID -> config selection, omitted-vs-empty behavior list semantics and per-row override precedence are missing. Keep base, override and effective refs separate.

source_reader_types.statement: Equipment files contain 424 SkillEquip and 150 SkillRelic ReadInfo entries, plus 49 None entries in the scoped definition sample. March CharacterConfig independently declares SkillTreeParam PointB2/PointB3 and SkillRank Rank01/02/04/06 readers.

missing_value_policy.statement: Keep ABSENT, NULL, EXPLICIT_ZERO, EMPTY_ARRAY and PRESENT_VALUE distinct. Do not repair truncated arrays or reuse adjacent rank/level values. Type None is not automatically zero.

parameter_binding.evaluation_boundary: No formulas, stat arithmetic, hash-name inversion or DynamicValue evaluation performed.

activation_predicates.effect_condition_boundary: HP, attack, crit, turn and event trigger conditions stay in frozen behavior domains. Keep them separate from enabling the content source.
activation_predicates.unknown_policy: No unproved requirement may become a default true/false or an omitted activation.
